Kforce has a client seeking a remote Software Engineer.

Summary:
This position will design, develop, execute, and maintain automated testing solutions using ACCELQ while also contributing to application development and enhancement efforts. The Software Engineer will build scalable automation frameworks and reusable assets that improve software quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities:
 
  Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites in ACCELQ covering business, system, integration, regression, and end-to-end requirements 
  Design reusable ACCELQ actions, scenarios, contexts, shared libraries, and other automation assets 
  Create automated testing solutions for web applications, APIs, databases, and integrated workflows 
  Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, stability, accuracy, and maintainability 
  Investigate automation failures and perform root-cause analysis across scripts, environments, integrations, and application functionality 
  Design, build, test, deploy, release, and support SaaS-based software solutions 
  Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support 
  Support continuous integration, continuous development, and deployment pipelines 
  Perform code reviews and verify and validate software changes 
  Maintain traceability among requirements, user stories, design artifacts, source code, test cases, defects, and release records 
  Evaluate system and component releases for potential impact on business processes 
  Collaborate with Agile teams to define user stories, acceptance criteria, executable specifications, and test scenarios 
  Apply Behavior-Driven Development, Test-Driven Development, and other quality-focused engineering practices 
  Partner with product management, engineering, quality, regulatory, and software validation teams 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related discipline 
  Three or more years of experience working in a SaaS product-development or FDA-regulated medical-device software environment 
  Experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions; ACCELQ experience is strongly preferred 
  Proficiency with Java, JavaScript, and SQL 
  Experience with technologies such as Angular, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Kubernetes, and Kafka 
  Experience with Jira, Git/GitLab, or comparable release-management and application-lifecycle-management tools 
  Experience supporting software requirements, design, development, testing, and release activities 
  Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework environment 
  Ability to create and maintain formal documentation supporting regulated software-quality requirements 
  Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, collaboration, and communication skills 
  Reliable internet connectivity and the ability to travel up to 10% 
  Experience with Domain-Driven Design, event-driven architecture, or reactive programming is preferred
